description: Navigation behaviour that is not part of the navbar itself.

sectionAnchors.description: Give each section of the long pages (about, resume, contact) its own URL fragment, updated as the reader scrolls, so a section can be linked to directly. Opening a page with a fragment scrolls to that section. Scrolling itself is untouched — this does not snap the wheel to one section per gesture.

enabled.description: Off by default: no fragment is written and no observer runs. The section ids ship either way, so a hand-written /about#skills still lands in the right place — the address bar just does not follow the reader down the page.
